evals.prompt: I need end-to-end exactly-once from a replayable source into files on S3 in my Apache Flink 2.5 job. Which interfaces in this source tree implement the commit protocol, and how do I verify the guarantee actually holds under TaskManager failure?
evals.expected_output: Pointers to CommittingSinkWriter/SupportsCommitter/Committer and FileSink in this tree, explanation of the barrier-aligned two-phase commit, and a kill-a-TaskManager verification recipe with exact-set assertions.
assertions: Names flink-core/src/main/java/org/apache/flink/api/connector/sink2/CommittingSinkWriter.java or SupportsCommitter.java as the commit interface
Points to flink-connectors/flink-connector-files/.../sink/FileSink.java as the exactly-once file sink
Lists all three conditions: checkpointing enabled, replayable source, checkpoint-aligned sink commit
Verification step includes killing a TaskManager (or flink cancel) and asserting no missing AND no duplicate records

evals.prompt: Our Flink SQL job writes to a Kafka topic through a sink configured with at-least-once and we see duplicates after failures. Also give me a JSON filesystem DDL example I can EXPLAIN first on OSS Flink before touching the real pipeline.
evals.expected_output: Explanation that AT_LEAST_ONCE permits duplicates on recovery and what must change for exactly-once (sink with commit protocol + replayable source), plus a filesystem+JSON CREATE TABLE with WATERMARK and an EXPLAIN step.
assertions: Explains that at-least-once commits without checkpoint alignment so retries after failure produce duplicates
DDL declares `WATERMARK FOR event_time` before the WITH clause
Recommends EXPLAIN before submitting; does NOT recommend disabling checkpointing to stop duplicates

evals.prompt: Where in the Apache Flink source tree should I implement a custom source so I don't hand-roll the split fetch loop, and what are the four roles I must provide for a FLIP-27 source?
evals.expected_output: Recommendation to extend SourceReaderBase/SingleThreadMultiplexSourceReaderBase in flink-connector-base with a SplitReader and RecordEmitter, and enumeration of Source, SplitEnumerator, SourceSplit (with versioned serializer), SourceReader roles.
assertions: Names SourceReaderBase or SingleThreadMultiplexSourceReaderBase in flink-connectors/flink-connector-base
Lists Source, SplitEnumerator, SourceSplit, and SourceReader as the four roles
Does NOT recommend implementing SourceFunction (legacy, removed interface)
